gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-saurasht: Letters pinned far apart like cut-out shapes, that's Press Start 2P, a chunky retro display face with a playful streak. Noto Sans Saurashtra sits underneath with flat capitals and counters that stay open to the outside.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-sc: Press Start 2P has big, open-looking bowls and a faint modulation you only spot up close, which gives it a cheeky arcade charm. And Noto Sans SC follows with chalky curves that stop short of closing, keeping the page modern.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada has open c forms that never close into rings, with bulky lowercase proportions and a plain sans manner throughout. Press Start 2P adds the retro fun above it.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Approachable and contemporary, Noto Sans Siddham fills the text line with a large central band and an s whose ends hang far from the spine. But Press Start 2P brings the playful retro punch, with a gentle taper from stem to joint.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Press Start 2P sets cut-out style letters far apart for a fun retro look, with thin strokes of respectable weight. Noto Sans Sinhala simply lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P hints at moderate thick-thin modulation up close, with big open-looking bowls. And Noto Sans Soyombo gives it a sizable x-height and curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-sundanes: Noto Sans Sundanese keeps its e crossbars open-mouthed and leaves very little gap between x-height and cap height, a plain sans through and through. Noto Sans Sundanese handles the steady reading, while Press Start 2P supplies the pinned-apart, pencil-tapered retro fun.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Spacing like cut-out letters pinned far apart is what defines Press Start 2P, a fun retro display face with a slight swell on its bowls. Noto Sans Sunuwar follows as a sans with curves that leave daylight, like a rope's open bight.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-syloti-n: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri brings short ascenders, a tall x-height and an a whose lower bowl opens to breathe. And Press Start 2P tops it with curves a little heavier than its joins, for a retro grin.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac reads like a friendly plain sans, with tall lowercase bowls like blown glass bulbs and s shapes taking wide, easy turns. Press Start 2P adds fun above, with medium contrast and no sharp hairlines.
